rule: A parent with its own vulnerable row moves once: its row target is raised to the highest release a transitive row needs from it (qs needs express 4.22.3), and a row whose smallest admitting release is lower (path-to-regexp: 4.22.0) is lifted to that target when it still admits a clean copy there. One release, one command, across rows (audit H1, rules a, b, e); express is declared ^4.13.4, which already admits 4.22.3, so the command is the in-range refresh `npm update express` (fix_command fc-054), not an install that rewrites the declaration (E8 follow-up, 2026-10-18)
source: OWASP/NodeGoat package-lock.json (express 4.16.4 declared ^4.13.4, path-to-regexp 0.1.7, qs 6.5.2); registry.npmjs.org abbreviated documents (Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json) and OSV.dev /v1/query, read 2026-10-18; the same answer as @4da/mcp-server fix/planner-advice-625 1840dab upgrade_planner on NodeGoat (express 4.22.3 on the express, path-to-regexp and qs rows)

rule: The smallest parent release, above the installed one and clear of the parent's own advisories, whose own requirement resolves to a clean copy at or above the target (express 4.20.0..4.21.2 pin path-to-regexp 0.1.10 / 0.1.12; 4.22.0 requires ~0.1.12, which resolves to 0.1.13). The parent's own row (4.20.0, its own advisories' fix, still pins a vulnerable path-to-regexp) is raised to that release. The command keeps the declared exact pin (audit H1, rules a, b, e)
source: registry.npmjs.org abbreviated documents (Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json) and OSV.dev /v1/query, read 2026-10-18; express 4.16.4 as in OWASP/NodeGoat, declared exactly; the same answer as @4da/mcp-server fix/planner-advice-625 1840dab upgrade_planner on that project (express row 4.22.0, "4.22.0, not 4.20.0")

rule: When the new parent release's requirement still admits the installed vulnerable copy, an install keeps that copy, so the advice names the refresh that follows the install (audit H1, rule c)

rule: A parent that cannot be tied to a dependency the project declares still gets its release named, but no command: `npm install <transitive>@v` would add it as a direct dependency (audit H1, rule d)
